title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Civic Center on 1982-08-06
lineage: soundboard master cassette-> cassette-> DAT-> CDR-> .WAV-> SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard captures a solid early‑80s Dead show with a smoking Space jam, Brent’s tight keyboards and overall high energy.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear, near‑perfect soundboard quality, though one listener notes the bass is low in the mix. Musically the concert is described as solid and “smokin’,” highlighted by an eleven‑beat Space jam and strong Brent performances that exemplify the band’s 1982 form.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is 4.2; comments emphasize a high‑energy show with standout moments and generally excellent soundboard quality, offset only by minor mix issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Most reviewers call the sound crystal clear and perfect; one mentions a weak Phil bass presence in the mix, giving the recording a slightly lower technical rating.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall solid performance with good flow; no major hiccups reported.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Strong accents during the Space jam are highlighted, showing tight playing.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is noted as barely audible in the mix by one reviewer, though overall performance praised.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboard work is described as rounding into form and a highlight of the early‑80s sound.
